# Library Development Group - University of Sheffield

> A comprehensive referencing and citation guide resource supporting academic writers across the University of Sheffield.

This site provides detailed guidance on academic referencing styles and citation practices. It serves researchers, students, and faculty at the University of Sheffield who need authoritative instruction on formatting bibliographies and in-text citations.

## Key Topics

- IEEE referencing
- Citation styles
- Reference formatting
- In-text citations
- Reference lists
- Technical writing
- Numerical citations
- Referencing guides
- Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers
- University Library resources

## IEEE Referencing

- [IEEE referencing](https://librarydevelopment.group.shef.ac.uk/referencing/ieee.html): Guide to IEEE citation style for technical writing and reference formatting
